description: Bermuda's Department of Statistics publishes the 2016 Population and Housing Census report, parish profiles and a set of census district maps with boundary descriptions. The housing chapter compares 2016 with 2010 for occupied dwelling units by type of building, bedrooms, full bathrooms, tenure and rent, and appendix tables break private dwelling units down by the nine parishes; the appendix counts 27,418 private dwelling units, 2,327 of them in St. George's. Building types run from one-unit dwellings to buildings with seven or more apartments. Coverage is national. Format and access: free PDFs, no registration. Licence: not stated on the pages read. Caveats: the report has no tables on water supply, electricity, cooling or roof type, so it describes the building stock, not services; tables are inside PDFs. Simulation uses: dwelling counts and building types per parish as exposure inputs for hurricane and storm surge models, and district boundaries for linking other data. Related records: the ECLAC REDATAM hub for Caribbean census databases.
